headline: 新片零上映周内六部，蜘蛛侠奥德赛领跑热搜
headlineEn: Zero releases today, six this week; Spider-Man and Odyssey lead trending
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周共6部新片。热搜由《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《奥德赛》领跑，侠探杰克、小黄人与大怪兽等紧随其后。待映新片包括《逃出绝命街》《OK老板娘2》。
summaryEn: No movies release today; six open this week. Spider-Man: Brand New Day and Odyssey top the trending charts, with Jack Reacher, Minions and the Big Monster close behind. Upcoming titles include Escape from Death Street and OK! Madam 2.

industryHighlights.text: 今日零新片上映，本周累计6部新片。
industryHighlights.en: No films release today, but six arrive this week.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》持续占据本周热搜榜首。
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day continues to top this week's trending chart.

industryHighlights.text: 《逃出绝命街》与《OK老板娘2》成为近期最受期待待映片。
industryHighlights.en: Escape from Death Street and OK! Madam 2 are among the most anticipated upcoming titles.

industryHighlights.text: 本周热搜由超级英雄、经典IP续作及新原创题材共同主导。
industryHighlights.en: This week's trends are led by superhero fare, franchise titles, and fresh originals.
